name: llm-cliche-highlighter-extension
description: Browser extension (Chrome + Firefox) that highlights LLM cliches on the page you are reading.
author: Haider Alwasiti <wasiti14@gmail.com>

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint -s dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist/firefox
